newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on hedging, long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on hedging, long liquidation.

text.p: Hedge selling and fund long liquidation pressed CBOT rice futures to a lower close, traders said.

"We've lost about 40 cents (per cwt) this week on long liquidation plus there were some new short fund sellers," a trader said. Traders said there was a significant increase in hedging over he market on behalf of farmers.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, down from 769 Thursday.
Rice closed 2-1/2 to four cents per cwt lower, with November down four at $9.75 per cwt.
